name: Original 30-day pest-return model
question: Will a matched service have a recorded corrective return within 30 days?
inputs: 93 inputs: service/package, pest, previous visits and returns, location and environmental features. Extra Trees, 300 trees.
result: 100-service historical test: 5 positives; 94% accuracy, 40% precision, 40% recall. Always-no-return: 95%.
meaning: The later frozen refit trained on 5,695 services. Training rows are not a test. Configuration is verified; current cloud health was not checked for this guide.

name: Larger historical reference
question: Same 30-day question, evaluated on a larger historical population.
inputs: 93 inputs; same Extra Trees settings. Separate training 1,506, validation 1,177, assessment 2,075.
result: 184 positives; 77.7% accuracy, 23.0% precision, 64.7% recall. Existing calibrated Brier 0.0735.
meaning: Different fit, records and threshold from the 100-service result. This reference supports the new probability experiment; it does not replace the frozen collector.

name: 30-day probability comparison
question: How likely is a recorded return within 30 days?
inputs: Same fixed 93-input classifier; raw scores, sigmoid, logit, beta and isotonic calibration.
result: Validation chose isotonic. Assessment Brier 0.0740 vs existing 0.0735; constant risk 0.0808.
meaning: Lower is better. The new candidate beats constant risk but does not beat existing calibration. Keep existing method; no deployment or probability guarantee.

name: Claude’s property warranty risk
question: After a non-warranty appointment, will the same rounded-coordinate group have a warranty signal within 30 days?
inputs: 8 visit-history inputs; 200 Extra Trees plus Platt calibration.
result: 1,104 historical windows, 107 positives; AUC 0.767. At 20% threshold: 81.4% accuracy, 24.7% precision, 44.9% recall.
meaning: Not comparable directly with the original test. Timing corrections retain ranking; exact property identity and paid-service labels are not established. Its saved forward test starts before prediction creation and is not valid as claimed.

name: Pest-specific specialists
question: Does a separate pest-group model predict returns better?
inputs: Original 93 inputs and unchanged Extra Trees pipeline, fitted separately for supported pest groups.
result: Cockroach-only: 1,428 assessment services; 74.4% accuracy, 24.9% precision, 68.2% recall. General reference on same group: 72.6%, 23.8%, 70.1%.
meaning: Ranking barely changes. Other individual pests have too few positive training cases. Anchor pest is known; outcome is not necessarily the same pest.

name: Bookings — next two weeks
question: Bookings · next two weeks
inputs: 36 inputs; extra_trees. Calendar/history and booking context; exact contract in linked model.
result: Historical MAE 12.8 vs baseline 20.7; 13 test windows.
meaning: MAE is average absolute prediction error, in bookings or appointment hours. These are not pest-recurrence models. Packaged does not prove current cloud operation.

name: Appointment hours — next week
question: Appointment hours · next week
inputs: 32 inputs; ridge_100. Calendar/history and booking context; exact contract in linked model.
result: Historical MAE 9.0 vs baseline 11.8; 14 test windows.
meaning: MAE is average absolute prediction error, in bookings or appointment hours. These are not pest-recurrence models. Packaged does not prove current cloud operation.

name: Repeat purchase within 90 days
question: Which first-time customers might buy another programme?
inputs: Initial sale, purchase season and saved customer/package context; exact input list in the model.
meaning: Predicts another purchase, not pest recurrence. Scores are explicitly marked uncalibrated. It does not prove marketing causes additional purchases.

name: 60-day return after final service
question: Will a residential programme have a recorded return within 60 days after its final paid service?
inputs: Service inputs; logistic regression; multiple historical folds.
meaning: 92.5% is recall, not accuracy. Different question and population from the 30-day model. Current-source rebuild and a new future evaluation are required.

name: Quote, renewal and other targets
question: Commercial quotation, repeat-purchase timing, programme-end purchases, weekly sales and operational forecasts.
inputs: Each study has its own data, target, inputs, partition and baseline.
result: See study files and the searchable result index; there is no meaningful single accuracy across these questions.
meaning: Small property-size coverage limits quotation work. Some newer weekly-count searches did not beat a moving average. A saved result is not an operational model.
